responsibility: This file implements the storage container used for array and structure constructors in the Fortran front end. Using GCC splay trees keyed by element offset, it creates, copies, frees, inserts, appends, looks up, iterates, and removes gfc_constructor nodes, including support for repeated elements, so constructor-valued expressions can be represented sparsely and accessed efficiently by simplification, DATA initialization, array analysis, and lowering code.
same_name_distinction: Provides the actual splay-tree-based constructor container logic: node allocation/copy/free, insertion, append, lookup, iteration, and removal for gfc_constructor data. Unlike gcc/fortran/constructor.h, it contains the data-structure implementation rather than just the API.
